attchmntText: Lenskart Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Lenskart Solutions Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange and BSE. The report, issued by CARE Ratings Limited on November 5, 2026, was reviewed and approved by the Audit Committee on November 4, 2026. It pertains to the utilization of proceeds from the Company's Initial Public Offer, which had a fresh issue size of Rs. 2150 crore. During the quarter, the Company utilized Rs. 165.95 crore towards the objects of the issue. The report confirms no deviation from the objects, no change in the means of finance, and no major deviations observed compared to earlier reports. All utilization is stated to be in line with the Prospectus dated November 04, 2025. The details are also hosted on the Company's website.

attchmntText: Lenskart Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Earnings Call with respect to Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Lenskart Solutions Limited filed a transcript of the earnings call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, conducted on November 4, 2026. Revenue grew 32.5% year-on-year to 2,845 crores. EBITDA increased 46.6% to 624 crores. EBITDA Pre-Ind AS margin expanded to 13.8%. Profit after tax more than doubled to 232 crores. Half-year revenue reached 5,559 crores. The company added 165 net new stores globally, bringing the total to 3,624. India same-store sales growth was 20.8%. Net Promoter Score in India recovered to 79.6. Operating cash flow for the first half was 388 crores. Return on capital employed was 22.5% for the half-year. The transcript is available on the company website.
